newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end dull pre-Easter session.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end dull pre-Easter session.

text.p: 1710 GMT - Portuguese bonds ended a dull pre-Easter session little changed and dealers said the weakness of U.S. Treasuries and the dollar did not augur well for prices.
*Spread vs 10-yr Bund cash 97 bps vs 103 bps cls
Portuguese bonds ended a dull pre-Easter session little changed and dealers said the weakness of U.S. Treasuries and the dollar did not augur well for bond prices.
"We closed as we opened -- illiquid and without volatility because out futures and the Spanish market were closed," said one operator.
Another said: "The fall of Treasuries and the weakness of the dollar do not augur well for Portuguese bond prices in the near term. Cash and futures will probably open lower next Tuesday."
The escudo closed steady after an apathetic pre-holiday session. It stood at 100.55/65 per mark, compared with 100.54/56 at the close yesterday.
